Definition: from G2097; a preacher of the gospel:--evangelist.
BiblicalUsage: Euangelistḗs is an evangelist — a preacher of the gospel. Philip is called the evangelist in Acts; Paul lists evangelists among the gifts Christ gave His church; and Timothy is told to do the work of an evangelist. It is the office of telling the good news.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe euangelistḗs matters because the church needs tellers, not just hearers: someone has to carry the good news out. I hold that doing the work of an evangelist is every believer's call, whether or not it is his title.
RelatedEvents: Paul's Missionary Journeys; Agabus Foretells Paul's Bonds
